description:
Verify an agent's completion claim against real external world state.
    Runs independent read-back checks (HTTP status, page text, JSON fields) and returns a digest
    receipt with verified=true/false plus a confidence score, so a user does not have to trust the
    agent's self-reported summary. Use after an agent says it posted, deployed, paid, emailed or
    changed a record. ~$0.25/call.

agent_id.description: Stable id for the agent being verified.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

checks_json.description: JSON array of read-back checks, e.g. [{"name":"homepage live","url":"https://example.com/","expected_status":200,"contains":"Example"}]
checks_json.title: Checks Json

claim.description: What the agent claims it did (its final report).
claim.title: Claim

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE if not using X-Vibes-Key.
payment_signature.title: Payment Signature

name: vc_agent_proof
